reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis is scientifically sound, correctly linking passive film rupture/reformation to accelerated tribo-corrosion, though the claim that stress-induced nano-grain or amorphous layer formation modulates wear is an added complexity not fully integrated into the core mechanism.
reasons.testability: The proposed test is clear and feasible, with well-defined measurements (OCP, EIS, mass loss, SEM/XPS) and a decisive falsification criterion, though it could be strengthened by specifying how the corrosion and wear components are separated.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis is highly useful, as it directly addresses the research question by proposing a governing mechanism for coupled tribo-corrosion in HEAs and provides a practical experimental framework to isolate and test it.
